0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The elven man before you seems to be in a state of considerable distress.

48.original: Oh dear, oh no, oh my, aaaaaah...

49.original: Y-You there! Help! My wife is having a baby! A baby!

50.original: I was there, but...but the nurse said I was “making everyone anxious” and threw me out!

51.original: I came out here for fresh air... I'm having an awfully hard time breathing for some reason... But I can't just <hex:021A020203>wait<hex:021A020103>! You have to tell them to let me back in! Quickly!

53.original: Yes, a lovely baby girl. And both she and your wife are quite well, so please... Do calm down.

55.original: Goodness me, you brought the Exarch's guest with you!

56.original: Well, since you're already here, would you like to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>welcome<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> this little one to the world?

57.original: She is an adorable child. And surprisingly quiet, given...ahem.

58.original: This child is one of many precious things that you protected when you fought for the Crystarium. You should be proud.

60.original: I would be honored if you were to give our child your blessing.

62.original: Thank you─I'm sure that she understands. And this will make a wonderful story to tell when she's older.

63.original: Oh, I'm so happy I can barely breathe... Actually, I really can't breathe. I think I need to step outside for a moment.

64.original: Show the child that you care by giving her a big <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>welcome<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

66.original: Thank you for everything. None of us will ever forget this day, I'm sure.

67.original: Oh, yes, I'm fine... Just a bit overwhelmed, to be honest. I'm a <hex:021A020203>father<hex:021A020103>.

68.original: And to think that <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> were there to greet my daughter! She'll grow up knowing the tales of your heroism, I promise.
